rounds.ai_message: Good morning, this is Daniel from Sunrise Mill. How can I help you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好,我是 Sunrise 织厂的 Daniel,请问有什么可以帮您?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明来意:是来询梭织面料的,提大致规格
key_phrases: I need ... for a new style
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I want cloth' — say 'I am looking for a woven fabric supplier'
rounds.tips_zh: 第一次联系织厂先报公司 + 用途 + 大致规格

rounds.ai_message: Sure. What kind of fabric are you looking for? Cotton, polyester, blend, or something else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。请问您要找什么面料?棉、涤纶、混纺,还是其他?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 报成分(比如 100% 棉 或 CVC) + 用途(衬衣/西装/工装)
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I want T/C' without saying percentage — 'T/C 80/20' is clearer
rounds.tips_zh: 成分 + 比例 + 用途,一次说清

rounds.ai_message: Got it — 100% cotton for shirt fabric. What GSM are you targeting? And the weave — plain, twill, or oxford?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白 — 100% 棉做衬衣面料。请问您目标克重多少?织法 — 平纹、斜纹、还是牛津?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 报克重(比如 110-120 GSM)+ 织法(plain 是基础款,oxford 是休闲款)
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'around 100' — give a range 'between 110 and 130 GSM'
rounds.tips_zh: 克重和织法是基本规格,客户会问

rounds.ai_message: OK, 120 GSM plain weave, 60s x 60s count. We can do that. What quantity are you looking at?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好,120 GSM 平纹,60 支 x 60 支。我们可以做。请问您需要多少量?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 报一个大概的量(比如 5000 米 / 月),或最小起订量
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I don't know' — give a rough idea: 'initially 3000 meters, then monthly 5000'
rounds.tips_zh: 量给得越具体,报价越准

rounds.ai_message: For 3000 meters initial, our MOQ is 1000 meters per color. So you can split into 3 colors. Lead time is 25 days from lab dip approval. Sample yardage is free, but freight collect.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 首单 3000 米,我们每个颜色的 MOQ 是 1000 米。所以可以分 3 个颜色。从 lab dip 确认到出厂 25 天。打样免费,但运费到付。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 接受或谈 MOQ;问 lab dip 周期;确认颜色数量
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'OK that's fine' without re-confirming: 'MOQ 1000 m per color x 3 colors, lab dip in 7 days, 25 days after approval, OK'

rounds.ai_message: Great. Send me your tech pack with the Pantone codes, and I'll send you lab dips in 5 to 7 days. After your approval, we go to bulk. Shipping is from Shanghai port, FOB. Anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。发我您的工艺单和 Pantone 色号,我 5-7 天内发您 lab dip。您确认后我们做大货。从上海港出,FOB。还有别的问题吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认工艺单会发,问付款条件(LC/TT),结束
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'thanks bye' — re-confirm next step: 'Will send tech pack today, looking forward to lab dip. Thanks'
rounds.tips_zh: 电话结束:重述下一步 + 感谢,显得专业
